name: VoiceAgent Lite - Phone Call Logger
description: Logs phone calls from Vapi.ai or Bland.ai to Google Sheets via webhook. Captures caller info, duration, and transcript summary.

setupVars.label: voiceagent sheet id (was the n8n environment variable VOICEAGENT_SHEET_ID)

setup: "Call Received" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value voiceagentSheetId: voiceagent sheet id (was the n8n environment variable VOICEAGENT_SHEET_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /voiceagent-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Parse Call" (code.require): Allowlisted require() calls were rewritten or dropped for Transform (no module system).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## VoiceAgent Lite
Simple call logging.
No AI analysis, no calendar.
Just log calls to Sheets.
